name: @ziweijs/core
description: Node.js binding for the Ziwei chart engine

scripts.build: pnpm run build:types && napi build --platform --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml --package ziwei_binding --package-json-path package.json --output-dir . --js native.cjs --dts native.d.ts
scripts.build:release: pnpm run build:types && napi build --platform --release --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml --package ziwei_binding --package-json-path package.json --output-dir . --js native.cjs --dts native.d.ts
